note: Hand-checked aircraft regions (xyxy, original-frame pixels) for the aircraft photos in configs/detector/baseline.json parity_sample.real. They were drawn on 2026-09-26 from gridded views of the fetched photos, before any detector was run on them. They are test data, not ground truth for any benchmark.
rule: A photo is a required hit when the aircraft is whole (not cut off by the frame) and its region is at least 32 px wide in the 640 px model input (region width * min(640/H, 640/W); 32 px is COCO's small-object boundary). For a required photo, some AERIS class 0 detection must overlap the region with IoU >= 0.5. Other aircraft photos are only reported. The rule was fixed before any detection was seen.
